headline: Singapore Crypto Activity Hits $284 Billion on Institutional Inflows
summary: Chainalysis reported that cryptocurrency activity in Singapore reached $284 billion, supported by a 94% surge in institutional transactions alongside expanded regional peer-to-peer digital asset usage.
why: Singapore serves as a primary digital asset regulatory and institutional hub in the Asia-Pacific region, competing with Dubai and Hong Kong for fintech capital.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Substantial institutional crypto volume strengthens Singapore's position as a regulated fintech and digital asset center.
